steps.content: With guidance from the shackles and the pendant left by Norman, it's not hard to locate Hamel. She hasn't gone far and is still around where the main gate used to be.
When you find her, she's touching the broken ruins curiously, examining them carefully.

options: Hamel, what are you looking at?

choices.text: Hamel, what are you looking at?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Chief.
She seems unsurprised by your arrival.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I've seen the ugly, terrifying Carnival before it was shrouded by the illusions, and I've also seen it in its most bustling, prosperous prime under the fake delusion.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: But the Carnival ... it's the first time I've seen it like this.
In order to eradicate all risk of spreading Mania, most of the amusement facilities have already been removed. These remaining ones will probably be removed soon too.
Before long, this place will become a desert, or may even be covered again by the waste from the Rust.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I guess the DisCity will soon forget the Carnival, and forget me as well...
I will remember you, and I will help you remember what happened here. That's why I came here today.
That meddlesome jellyfish has already told you, hasn't it?
The sudden joke makes Hamel laugh. She presses her hands on her chest gently.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: It told me everything... You're willing to watch me dance, right?
Yes, even though I'm the only audience.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Only one... is good enough.
Along the desolate bank, only you, Hamel, and two shadows elongated by the sun are walking side by side.
You need to continue into the depths of the remains of the Carnival and go back to the stage at the center of the lake that belongs only to Hamel.
Around here is where I met the three puppets, Void, Misery, and Fear. They all loved your dance. Do you still remember?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Void, Misery, and Fear... Are these their names?
Yes.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Such sad names...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I recall part of it now... My dance could help them forget their troubles briefly, but it couldn't truly console these souls.
She reaches out her hand, brushing through the invisible air, and three tiny jellyfish illusions emerge before you.
Unlike the phantom that symbolizes solitude and restraints, these three chubby jellyfish are small and adorable.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Go, go to that world free of trouble. When they're in need of my dance, you'll keep them company in my stead.
Hamel waves her hand, and the three tiny jellyfish rise in the air unhurriedly.
Though you know this is merely a visual ceremony and they can't really reach another world like this, you still can't help lifting your gaze to see the three little jellyfish off in the sky.
You keep going in the direction you're given until the soil not far ahead reveals a large stretch of charred remains left by an intense battle.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: You faced danger here?
It was impersonating you, that...
You're not sure if you can call that thing a person.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: You've mentioned that there was another Hamel here.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I think... I once knew her existence. She was the center of the blissful realm, but also the loneliest child here, wasn't she?
What did you recall?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: A baby's lonely cries that form part of the music of the dance. Perhaps I've known her well since long ago.
She envied you for getting the love from everyone in the Carnival, that's why she impersonated you.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Envied me...
Hamel crouches down to feel the soil's temperature with her fingertips carefully, as if interacting with her impersonator in this way.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: How lucky you are, to know what you want. I should be the envious one.
A small flower blooms where her fingertips are touching.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: The soil, the air, the sun, and the rain, they'll all love you... This time, please thrive.
The flower is only a tiny illusion, yet its leaves still sway as the wind blows by it.
You continue walking for a while. You're getting closer to your destination, and there are fewer and fewer objects in your surroundings.
Finally, before a stretch of empty, flat land, Hamel grinds to a halt.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: This place feels... familiar?
This was once a sacred territory in the Carnival. The crowd of the parade guarding Hamel's dance blocked off the area completely.
After the Black Ring shattered, this place became a deep lake that suppressed tens of thousands of Corruptors.
You once put the shackles on Hamel here and promised to take her out of this place. Sadly, she's already forgotten that.
Now that the illusions have all faded away, this place turns out to be just a stretch of empty, bare land...

Hamel tries to take one step forward, then another, then another... Her steps are gradually picking up a rhythm, as if she's getting used to the touch on her toe tips and her body is becoming lighter and lighter.
Once she reaches the center, she turns to face the only audience today. The audience is quietly waiting for her performance to begin, but she can't calm down her heart...

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: To dance freely for everything you perceive... Have you made this wish come true?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I don't know. But he's removed the restraints on my powers. I can dance with everything I've got for this show.
steps.female_content: I don't know. But she's removed the restraints on my powers. I can dance with everything I've got for this show.

steps.speaker: Norman
steps.content: But what if he's only trying to loosen your guard, what if he's just lying to you and using you like all those people in the past?!
steps.female_content: But what if she's only trying to loosen your guard, what if she's just lying to you and using you like all those people in the past?!

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: No... I can feel it. He... he's different.
steps.female_content: No... I can feel it. She... she's different.

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: How is he different? From what I see, he's not really different from that stupid audience in your memories!
steps.female_content: How is she different? From what I see, she's not really different from those stupid audience in your memories!

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: No. Please don't speak of him like this.
steps.female_content: No. Please don't speak of her like this.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Then what exactly is the difference?

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: The thoughts hidden at the end of the memories are being uncovered layer by layer.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: Stop hiding your desires. It's about time, let the story between you and him reemerge in your mind.
steps.female_content: Stop hiding your desires. It's about time, let the story between you and her reemerge in your mind.

steps.content: Even if there's a dark hollow in my heart, I don't need to fill it with anything. I will carry it and keep on fighting.
Dance for yourself, Hamel. I don't need you to protect me from hell.
The shackles didn't point me in the wrong direction. I should've known you're here sooner.
I came to see you, Hamel.
You've done enough. You don't need to make sacrifices anymore. We're going back together, like I promised. I can't leave you here alone!
That phantom with a physical form said you were confused, perplexed, and lonely... But that's not your fault.
You managed to spend 23 years in the Black Ring, and have prevented Norman and more people from slipping into danger. You've already done an excellent job.
Hamel has always considered others' feelings first and buried her most earnest wishes in the deepest corner of her heart, leaving them to pile up there.
Confusion, perplexity, and loneliness... Still, I need to thank you, for letting me see her nightmares, so I could help her put those thoughts into words.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Right, why couldn't I recall... He's different, he's different from everything in this world woven with pain.
steps.female_content: Right, why couldn't I recall... She's different, she's different from everything in this world woven with pain.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Disasters have brought crumbling dust and ash, and hysterical sadness has composed a pessimistic future. But behind the dust and ashes...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: There is glistening starlight.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: He hopes you can do as you please.
steps.female_content: She hopes you can do as you please.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: Make your choice, how you're going to dance...
Hamel?
I thought you were going to dance? Why are you spacing out...
She suddenly comes before you and picks up your hands.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Can you... dance with me?
The sudden invitation catches you off guard. Before you have time to consider your answer, you've already followed her to the center of the stage.
Hamel smiles and doesn't answer, simply crossing her fingers with yours.
She keeps her gaze on you. Slowly, the surrounding sounds are beginning to blur and you've caught up with her pace.
Is this the world you perceive? This is different from the memories in your nightmares.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: This is... you, perceived by me.
The hem of her dress extends freely to form a scroll of canvas. As if you've already rehearsed it many times, the two of you compose a new illusion on it.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Together, let's dance to our hearts' content...
She leads you to start twirling. You're standing so close to each other that you can even hear her peaceful breaths and feel the throbbing joy in her pulse.
The illusion created by the duet dance is starkly different from the Frozen Lake, portraying the warmth on a spring day.

Grass is thriving and warblers are twittering... It's as if the natural scenery is reciting a poem full of love, sometimes subtle and intimate, sometimes intense and passionate, layering it onto this once-destroyed land again and again.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: Her dance has changed?

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: No coercion, no scheme. This joyful song is purely her heart's creation.

steps.speaker: Fear Puppet
steps.content: Then will she still sing about sadness and pain for us?

steps.speaker: Misery Puppet
steps.content: No, we're no longer her last audience.

steps.speaker: Norman
steps.content: It's time to say goodbye.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: This time...

steps.speaker: Crazy Puppet
steps.content: It's the true farewell.
Is someone speaking?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: That's the sound of blessing...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Thump... Thump... They're blessing this dance...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: That the curtains of its stage shall never fall.
